title: 영역 믹스 솔로 #033 · 매체+명화 믹스 · 세로 띠·물결 · 4영역(옵아트 체커보드+칸딘스키+로스코+맨살) · 부분 맨살 · siren bust hourglass · 와이드 스탠스 · Black · 배경 검정 스튜디오 · 메이크업 없음(블루블랙)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 30s goddess, siren bust hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, half-up half-down jet-black hair — her body is painted in 3 different painting styles at once, each style claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 vertical bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 23% of the way across her figure from her left edge, about 49% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 70% of the way across her figure from her left edge. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it carries black-and-white op-art checkerboard distorted into a bulging optical illusion. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries Kandinsky style abstract composition of bold circles, triangles and sweeping lines in saturated red, blue, yellow and black. Region 3 is the strip between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries Rothko style colour fields, soft-edged stacked rectangles of deep crimson, orange and maroon glowing like light. Region 4 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it stays her own bare living skin with a natural satin sheen. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course, every painting laid on her own living skin, and the last region left as natural bare skin. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: standing in a wide stance facing the camera straight on, both hands resting on her flared hips, her legs fully in view — most extreme siren bust hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of glossy electric orange leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in electric orange lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large hoop earrings of polished gold with blackened iron accents as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, bare natural brows and bare natural lips in her own deep tones, large eyes with bright real catchlights.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows satin skin finish, smooth silky sheen.

Background: a pure black studio void with soft key light shaping her body, nothing else in frame. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
